Joining, getting called and the 3-minute window

Find a queue on Browse and tap Join. You get a number and your place in line, and the wait updates as the counter serves people.

When it's your turn, Quapp calls you. If the queue uses presence confirmation, tap "I'm here" within 3 minutes, or the slot goes to the next person.

You can hold tickets for more than one queue, as long as their hours don't overlap on the same day.
Proximity check, presence confirmation, no-show cooldown

Proximity check: some queues only take people within a set distance of the venue. Your location is read once, when you tap Join, and isn't tracked after that.

Presence confirmation: when you're called, tap "I'm here" within 3 minutes.

No-show cooldown: missing 2 slots blocks you from queues with this rule for 30 minutes. Queues without it stay open to you.

Each queue lists the checks it uses under "How this queue works".
What counts as a no-show, and what doesn\'t

Running late? Tap "I need more time" on your ticket, or "Move me back" when you're called. Say how many minutes you need and Quapp moves you back that far. You keep your number. It works once per ticket and never counts as a no-show.

Leaving a queue gives your place up for good. It isn't a no-show either.

A no-show is when you're called and don't confirm in time, or an organizer removes a fake join.

If an organizer closes a queue, nobody in it gets a no-show.
